t: This is a terrace of nineteenth-century houses at numbers 12, 14 and 16 Hans Road, in Knightsbridge. Two architects designed them. Arthur Heygate Mackmurdo was a progressive designer who influenced the Arts and Crafts movement, notably through the Century Guild of Artists, and is seen as a pioneer of the Modern Style, which fed into Art Nouveau. Charles Voysey began as a designer of wallpapers, fabrics and furnishings, contributed to the Modern Style, and is renowned for his country houses. Together they make this short terrace worth a close look.
